title: Sam’s Place - Close to Broadway, Sleeps 8
description:
Enjoy a comfortable and relaxing stay at this modern, new home only 2.6 miles away from the famous Nashville honky tonks on Broadway. This 3 bedroom home sleeps up to 8 guests and is the perfect headquarters for any trip to Nashville. Conveniently located on a quiet residential street, Sam’s Place offers easy access to the city’s most popular spots like Nissan Stadium, Bridgestone Arena, Music Row, and Broadway. 

Book now! Before someone else does.

The space
In addition to access to the full house, this unit also features a large 4+ car driveway, a wrap-around yard, and a fully-enclosed back patio - perfect for enjoying the beautiful Tennessee Weather. 

Professionally Cleaned
Fully equipped with fast fiber wifi.
4K 65" TV 
Shower Gel & Shampoo included
Easy access with digital locks
Fully loaded Kitchen
Beautiful back porch screened in
Active home security system with panic button

Guest access
Full access to 3 bedrooms, 2.5 baths, flex space room, kitchen, living room, dining room, enclosed patio, and backyard. 

**4+ car parking on-site**

Other things to note
Driving Distances:

to Broadway/Bridgestone - 12 minutes (2.6 miles)
to Music Row - 10 minutes (2.0 miles)
to Germantown - 10 minutes (2.3 miles)
to Nissan Stadium 15 minutes (3.4 miles)
to 12 South - 14 minutes (6.2 miles)
to Sylvan Park - 9 minutes (3.0 miles)
to Airport 17 minutes (11 miles)
to Grand Ole Opry 23 minutes (15 miles)
to Starbucks (1 mile)
